# CIDBI Builders

> CIDBI (Creations India Developers Builders Infrastructures) is an ISO 9001:2015 certified real estate builder based in Thrissur, Kerala, developing residential apartments, flats, and other construction projects since 2005.

## About

- CIDBI (Creations India Developers Builders Infrastructures) is a professionally managed construction and real estate company headquartered in Thrissur, Kerala, established in 2005 and led by Mr. A A Abdul Lathif.
- The company has developed more than 110 lakh sq. ft. of built space, including residential flats/apartments, office and shopping complexes, educational institutions, and hospitals in and around Thrissur.
- CIDBI manages construction in-house (design through delivery) without relying on external contractors, and is certified ISO 9001:2015, and affiliated with CREDAI and BAI.
- Target audience: homebuyers, families, investors, and NRIs looking to purchase premium, luxury, or budget flats and apartments in Thrissur, Kerala.

## Services / Products

- [Ongoing Projects](https://cidbi.com/ongoing-projects): Residential apartment projects currently under construction.
- [Cassia](https://cidbi.com/ongoing-projects/cassia): An ongoing residential flat project by CIDBI.
- [Chembaka Premium Luxury Apartments](https://cidbi.com/ongoing-projects/chembaka-premium-luxury-apartments): Ongoing premium 2 & 3 BHK luxury apartment project in Punkunnam, Thrissur, with amenities including a swimming pool, gym, home theatre, and EV charging.
- [Featured Projects](https://cidbi.com/featured-projects): Highlighted current and premium CIDBI developments.
